blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.7
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.7

blocks.text: मोहजयादनन्ताभोगात्सहजविद्याजयः
blocks.directed: [slowly] मोहजयादनन्ताभोगात्सहजविद्याजयः

blocks.text: Mohajayād anantābhogāt sahajavidyājayaḥ.
blocks.directed: Mohajayād anantābhogāt sahajavidyājayaḥ.

blocks.text: Through boundless conquest of delusion comes mastery of innate knowledge.
blocks.directed: Through boundless conquest of delusion comes mastery of innate knowledge.

blocks.text: Defeat Māyā, Unlock the Infinite, and Discover the Knowledge You Never Actually Lost.
blocks.directed: Defeat Māyā, Unlock the Infinite, and Discover the Knowledge You Never Actually Lost.

blocks.text: Right.
blocks.directed: [short pause] Right.

blocks.text: Now we’re getting somewhere.
blocks.directed: Now we’re getting somewhere.

blocks.text: Because after warning us about siddhis, Vasugupta gives the actual direction of the practice.
blocks.directed: Because after warning us about siddhis, Vasugupta gives the actual direction of the practice.

blocks.text: Not the accumulation of extraordinary abilities.
blocks.directed: Not the accumulation of extraordinary abilities.

blocks.text: But the conquest of delusion and the manifestation of sahajavidyā.
blocks.directed: But the conquest of delusion and the manifestation of sahajavidyā.

blocks.text: Innate knowledge.
blocks.directed: Innate knowledge.

blocks.text: Let’s unpack the compound.
blocks.directed: Let’s unpack the compound.

blocks.text: Moha — delusion.
blocks.directed: Moha — delusion.

blocks.text: Jaya — conquest, victory.
blocks.directed: Jaya — conquest, victory.

blocks.text: Ananta — endless, boundless.
blocks.directed: Ananta — endless, boundless.

blocks.text: Ābhoga — expansion, extension, pervasive reach.
blocks.directed: Ābhoga — expansion, extension, pervasive reach.

blocks.text: Sahaja — innate, natural, born together with.
blocks.directed: Sahaja — innate, natural, born together with.

blocks.text: Vidyā — knowledge.
blocks.directed: Vidyā — knowledge.

blocks.text: Jayaḥ — conquest or mastery.
blocks.directed: Jayaḥ — conquest or mastery.

blocks.text: And this word sahaja is absolutely beautiful.
blocks.directed: And this word sahaja is absolutely beautiful.

blocks.text: Because it doesn’t mean you’ve constructed something entirely new.
blocks.directed: Because it doesn’t mean you’ve constructed something entirely new.

blocks.text: It points to something intrinsic.
blocks.directed: It points to something intrinsic.

blocks.text: Something belonging to your own nature.
blocks.directed: Something belonging to your own nature.

blocks.text: So what is the knowledge being revealed?
blocks.directed: So what is the knowledge being revealed?

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja identifies it with the recognition of the supreme nature of consciousness, particularly through the movement towards Śivavyāpti.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja identifies it with the recognition of the supreme nature of consciousness, particularly through the movement towards Śivavyāpti.

blocks.text: And now we need to introduce two extremely important terms.
blocks.directed: And now we need to introduce two extremely important terms.

blocks.text: Ātmavyāpti.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Ātmavyāpti.

blocks.text: Śivavyāpti.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Śivavyāpti.

blocks.text: Vyāpti means pervasion or permeation.
blocks.directed: Vyāpti means pervasion or permeation.

blocks.text: Ātmavyāpti is the attainment or recognition of one’s own conscious Self, beyond the limiting identifications constituting ordinary individuality.
blocks.directed: Ātmavyāpti is the attainment or recognition of one’s own conscious Self, beyond the limiting identifications constituting ordinary individuality.

blocks.text: Śivavyāpti is the fuller recognition of the supreme Śiva-nature, including the universal manifestation and divine powers.
blocks.directed: Śivavyāpti is the fuller recognition of the supreme Śiva-nature, including the universal manifestation and divine powers.

blocks.text: These are technical levels within the doctrinal explanation, not merely two interchangeable synonyms for having a nice meditation.
blocks.directed: These are technical levels within the doctrinal explanation, not merely two interchangeable synonyms for having a nice meditation.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja, citing the Svacchandatantra, distinguishes them.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja, citing the Svacchandatantra, distinguishes them.

blocks.text: The practitioner first moves beyond identification with the bonds of limited existence.
blocks.directed: The practitioner first moves beyond identification with the bonds of limited existence.

blocks.text: But the movement does not end with the recognition of an isolated inner consciousness.
blocks.directed: But the movement does not end with the recognition of an isolated inner consciousness.

blocks.text: It culminates in the universal recognition of Śiva’s nature.
blocks.directed: It culminates in the universal recognition of Śiva’s nature.

blocks.text: And this is where Trika differs sharply from interpretations that describe liberation simply as the discovery of a passive witnessing principle separate from the world.
blocks.directed: And this is where Trika differs sharply from interpretations that describe liberation simply as the discovery of a passive witnessing principle separate from the world.

blocks.text: For Trika, the supreme consciousness is not merely a witness.
blocks.directed: For Trika, the supreme consciousness is not merely a witness.

blocks.text: It is svatantra.
blocks.directed: It is svatantra.

blocks.text: Free.
blocks.directed: Free.

blocks.text: Creative.
blocks.directed: Creative.

blocks.text: Self-revealing.
blocks.directed: Self-revealing.

blocks.text: The source of manifestation.
blocks.directed: The source of manifestation.

blocks.text: So the fullest recognition is not simply:
blocks.directed: [short pause] So the fullest recognition is not simply:

blocks.text: “I am the awareness watching everything.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am the awareness watching everything.”

blocks.text: It’s the much more radical understanding:
blocks.directed: [short pause] It’s the much more radical understanding:

blocks.text: “The reality of awareness is inseparable from the divine power through which everything manifests.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “The reality of awareness is inseparable from the divine power through which everything manifests.”

blocks.text: Now, Kṣemarāja connects this movement with Unmanā.
blocks.directed: Now, Kṣemarāja connects this movement with Unmanā.

blocks.text: A state beyond ordinary conceptual mind, associated with the supreme divine condition.
blocks.directed: A state beyond ordinary conceptual mind, associated with the supreme divine condition.

blocks.text: And here’s an important distinction.
blocks.directed: And here’s an important distinction.

blocks.text: Ordinary knowledge proceeds through successive cognitions.
blocks.directed: Ordinary knowledge proceeds through successive cognitions.

blocks.text: You know one thing.
blocks.directed: You know one thing.

blocks.text: Then another.
blocks.directed: Then another.

blocks.text: Then another.
blocks.directed: Then another.

blocks.text: But the supreme knowledge described here isn’t merely the accumulation of many individual cognitions.
blocks.directed: But the supreme knowledge described here isn’t merely the accumulation of many individual cognitions.

blocks.text: It is the nondual recognition of the universal conscious reality.
blocks.directed: It is the nondual recognition of the universal conscious reality.

blocks.text: The yogi does not become liberated by collecting every piece of information in the cosmos.
blocks.directed: The yogi does not become liberated by collecting every piece of information in the cosmos.

blocks.text: You don’t need to memorise the entire contents of Wikipedia.
blocks.directed: You don’t need to memorise the entire contents of Wikipedia.

blocks.text: Thank God.
blocks.directed: Thank God.

blocks.text: You’ve already got enough Sanskrit to learn.
blocks.directed: You’ve already got enough Sanskrit to learn.

blocks.text: What is required is a transformation of the fundamental standpoint of knowing.
blocks.directed: What is required is a transformation of the fundamental standpoint of knowing.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja describes the transition from limited self-recognition towards the universal condition of Śiva, emphasising that Āṇavopāya can culminate in Śāktopāya and the fuller awakening of innate knowledge. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja describes the transition from limited self-recognition towards the universal condition of Śiva, emphasising that Āṇavopāya can culminate in Śāktopāya and the fuller awakening of innate knowledge. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: And now, ladies and gentlemen, something extraordinary happens.
blocks.directed: And now, ladies and gentlemen, something extraordinary happens.

blocks.text: Because Vasugupta is about to explain what the world looks like when this knowledge has arisen.
blocks.directed: Because Vasugupta is about to explain what the world looks like when this knowledge has arisen.

blocks.text: And the answer is absolutely gorgeous.
blocks.directed: And the answer is absolutely gorgeous.

blocks.text: The universe becomes the yogi’s own light.
blocks.directed: The universe becomes the yogi’s own light.

blocks.text: Not an enemy.
blocks.directed: Not an enemy.

blocks.text: Not an illusion to be despised.
blocks.directed: Not an illusion to be despised.

blocks.text: Not a foreign territory from which consciousness needs to escape.
blocks.directed: Not a foreign territory from which consciousness needs to escape.

blocks.text: The world becomes the radiance of the Self.
blocks.directed: The world becomes the radiance of the Self.

blocks.text: Which means we’re about to enter one of the most beautiful passages in the entire Śiva Sūtras.
blocks.directed: Which means we’re about to enter one of the most beautiful passages in the entire Śiva Sūtras.

blocks.text: The cosmic theatre.
blocks.directed: The cosmic theatre.

blocks.text: And Śiva, the absolute show-off, is taking centre stage.
blocks.directed: And Śiva, the absolute show-off, is taking centre stage.
